## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and expected behavior. Include the affected contract or CLI command.

## Change scope

- [ ] Application logic
- [ ] Contract or schema migration
- [ ] Security or approval boundary
- [ ] Documentation or automation

## Verification

List the commands actually run and their results. Explain any checks not run.

## Data and compatibility

Describe database migration effects, approval invalidation, rollback approach, and handling of existing orders. Use synthetic examples only.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Model output remains data; no generated Python or SQL is executed.
- [ ] New failure paths have behavioral tests.
- [ ] Source data and credentials are absent from API payloads and commits.
- [ ] Documentation and validation evidence reflect the final change.
- [ ] Contract changes increment the contract version.
